title: Using Conformal Win Probability to Predict the Winners of the Cancelled 2020 NCAA Basketball Tournaments
key_result: Conformal win/spread probabilities for NCAA hoops; GSE layer for game-outcome probabilities with finite-sample coverage.

title: EDGE: a closed-form directed test for the calibration of probabilistic binary classifiers
key_result: EDGE directed calibration test: detects signed, structured miscalibration (over/under-confidence patterns) with closed-form asymptotics; GSE QC gate for directional bias.

title: A Ranking Approach for Measuring Calibration
key_result: rankECE: tuning-free calibration measure (sorted-residual cross-products), approximates l2-ECE better than binned ECE; asymptotic+finite-sample tests; Thm B.1 actionability bound; orders of magnitude faster than SKCE-U.

title: Calibrated Predictive Distributions from Sample Generators
key_result: CPIT: convert Monte Carlo samples into calibrated predictive CDFs; PIT-centrality wrapper with marginal coverage >=1-alpha; uniform calibration-map error bound via DKW.

title: Reaching the Tail: Calibration Diversity Drives Conformal Coverage under Data Scarcity
key_result: Calibration-set diversity (support width p95-p5), not rare-event count, drives conformal coverage under scarcity; diversity-maximizing selector fixes long-horizon coverage where Mondrian/PID/extreme-value baselines fail.

title: Enforcing Tail Calibration When Training Probabilistic Forecast Models
key_result: twCRPS training + TMCB tail-calibration diagnostic for extremes; CPIT-MCB-only penalization overpredicts exceedances (intensity vs occurrence dilemma); both tail penalties improve out-of-sample tail calibration at some overall-skill cost.

title: Who Has the Best Probabilities? Luck Versus Skill in Prediction Tournaments
key_result: Statistical separation of public-record prediction skill from luck in tournaments; proper-score-based skill significance with elliptical-score appendix.

title: Probabilistic Forecasting via Post-Processing Prediction Errors: In- or Out-of-Sample?
key_result: HS/CP/QR/GARCH post-processing of point-forecast errors on 14,407 M4 monthly series; all 8 variants beat Gaussian benchmark (up to 4.6% CRPSS); in-sample calibration wins 11/12 combos and costs ~200x less than rolling-origin out-of-sample.

title: Conformal Prediction Algorithms for Time Series Forecasting: Methods and Benchmarking
key_result: Benchmark of CP time-series wrappers (MSCP, EnbPI, SPCI, Global-CP, ACI/AcMCP) on >3,000 monthly sales series: MSCP (horizon-specific split CP) is the most efficient valid method; ACI competitive under shift.

title: Rollcast: Proper-Score Gated Rolling Anchors for Adaptive Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
key_result: Rolling statistical anchors + nearest-state residual archives + softmax gate trained on log score + state-adaptive persistence; synthetic 8-DGP benchmark: 86.2%/91.5% coverage at nominal 90/95, CRPS 14.4% above oracle.

title: Halo: Improving Forecast Accuracy through Heteroscedastic Estimation
key_result: Dual-head (location+scale) retraining under matching NLL (beta-NLL) improves point estimates themselves: 28/30 MSE/MAE wins on 5 electricity markets, MSE cut 2.6-16.5%; architecture choice matters less than estimating scale at all.

title: An Interval-Score ROC Curve for Assessment, Calibration and Ensembling of Probabilistic Forecasts
key_result: IS-ROC curve: (mean width, mean miss distance) frontier; oracle curve Pareto-optimal and convex; tangent calibration g(alpha), convex-hull ensembling with per-alpha forecaster selection; quantile recalibration map.
